findings.message: The committed terms entry "task contract" applies in 1a5289cd-52cf-4496-a1f6-e565820ea5e4 and 7bbac74f-668b-4d1f-9338-6495f420993a, whose surrounding text sits at cosine 0.60 — below the 0.62 coherence floor, so the two contexts are about as related as two requirements that share no vocabulary at all. If "task contract" means two different things here, this one entry fuses them into a single atom and a genuine conflict between the two can no longer be proven.
findings.suggestion: Read both requirements. If they are two concepts, split the entry: `symspec term "<canonical>" "task contract" --remove`, then two `symspec term` commands naming the two concepts separately. If one word across two concerns is intended, leave it — cosine cannot tell those apart, which is why this is a suggestion and moves no verdict.
